note: Status aligned to the GV row: Rabbit shut down in July 2019 after a failed round and on 2019-07-31 its remaining assets (intellectual property, software stack and patents) were acquired by Kast (Wikipedia, Rabb.it), which GV's book reads as acquired with Kast as successor. Redwood City is from the GV row (the company's 2015 Form D address). TechCrunch (2013-02-28) reports the $3.3M seed from Google Ventures and others, without Bessemer; the firm's own date is 2015-05-21, the time of the unnamed 2015 round the GV row records, so the stage stays undetermined.

Techcircle (2018-11-05): in January 2017 Wydr raised its Series A from Bessemer Venture Partners, Stellaris Venture Partners, Axis Capital and Jungle Ventures, after an angel round in October 2015; the firm's own date is 2016-12-19. The same article calls the company Gurugram-headquartered.

The firm's Innovati is Innoviti Payment Solutions of Bangalore: same business and 2017 date as the innoviti row, which is this company under its correct spelling. VCCircle (2019-03-15): Innoviti last raised $18M in July 2017 in a Series B from the SBI-FMO Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners and existing investor Catamaran Ventures, after a $5M Series A in July 2015 without Bessemer. Entry at the Series B, so Growth.

EventHubs (2018-07-26, following Forbes): the $37M raised for TSM's parent company Swift was Series A funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners, which put in $25M of it; that is the $25M investment reported in January 2018 and matches the firm's own date of 2018-02-12.

basis: Sale consideration, the firm's Eave position (decisions.md R6): the firm lists this entry as 'HomeLight (fka Eave)' and describes 'HomeLight Home Loans (formerly Eave)'; HomeLight acquired Eave, a digital mortgage startup, in July 2019 (Wikipedia, HomeLight). Eave is the row in this base, on the firm's own 2016 investment, and no Bessemer round in HomeLight itself is on record.

note: TechCrunch (2020-11-23): Friday closed a $2.1M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. Mainebiz the same day calls it a Portland, Maine startup and says Underscore led a $450,000 round earlier that year. The company's own notice (https://friday.app/p/shutting-down) says it was shutting down and turning the app off on 2022-06-03, so defunct. Graduation left for the graduation pass.

TechCrunch (2024-01-17): the $25M Series B was co-led by 83North and Bessemer, which also co-led the London startup's previous round of $26M; Business Insider's May 2022 piece on that round files it as a Series A, and TechCrunch (2025-01-21) puts total funding near $100M, which those three rounds account for. Entry at the $26M Series A; the firm's partnered year is 2021 and the announcement came in May 2022. London (GB) confirmed.

TechCrunch (2021-10-15): Spot AI came out of stealth with $22M, a $20M Series A led by Redpoint Ventures with Bessemer Venture Partners also participating, and an earlier $2M seed from angels, Village Global and Stanford StartX. Entry at the Series A, as the Redpoint row reads.

Boxed's own release of 2013-11-14 says it announced a $1.1M seed round from Social Starts, ENIAC Ventures and Bessemer Venture Partners in August 2013, so the entry is the seed, eight years before the 2021 listing (no public-purchase question). Graduation left for the graduation pass.

Stage still undetermined. Entrackr (2025-05-09): Bessemer led the Rs 224 crore Series C and was already the second-largest outside shareholder before it; the firm's own post (2026-06-18) says it had invested in multiple rounds before the $40M round it led. The firm's partnered year is 2024, so the entry was a round before the Series C; Google News searches for a 2024 round naming Bessemer found none.
